helio.unsupported: Not available: %s. Copy the debug report for details.
helio.preset.off.tooltip: Vanilla rendering. DLSS and Reflex stay available.
helio.preset.performance.tooltip: Highest frame rate: frame generation and Reflex Boost.
helio.preset.balanced.tooltip: Good-looking ray tracing at a high frame rate.
helio.preset.ultra.tooltip: Everything maxed. Needs a fast GPU.
helio.preset.photo.tooltip: For screenshots: no generated frames, best quality.
helio.lighting.path_traced.tooltip: Everything ray traced: soft shadows, shadows from torches and lamps, light bouncing between surfaces. Cleaned up by Ray Reconstruction.
helio.lighting.hybrid.tooltip: Ray-traced sun and moon shadows and reflections; light from torches and the sky comes from vanilla's light levels. Much faster, no denoiser needed.
helio.dlss_quality.tooltip: Resolution ray tracing renders at before DLSS upscales it: DLAA native, Quality 67%, Balanced 58%, Performance 50%, Ultra Performance 33% of the window in each direction. Lower is faster and softer.
helio.rt_distance.tooltip: How far rays can hit geometry, capped by render distance. Lower builds less off-screen geometry.
helio.frame_generation.tooltip: DLSS Frame Generation. Inserts AI-generated frames between rendered ones. Works best with VSync on and 60+ rendered fps.
helio.reflex.tooltip: NVIDIA Reflex lowers input latency. Boost also keeps GPU clocks up.
helio.accumulate.tooltip: Averages frames while the camera and world are still, for a clean, anti-aliased reference picture. Moving mobs smear while it's on.
helio.cave_brightness.tooltip: Least light in caves and enclosed spaces, as a share of the open-air minimum set by Brightness. Lower is darker.
helio.ray_reconstruction.tooltip: DLSS Ray Reconstruction cleans up soft shadows and bounce light every frame. Off shows simpler lighting without noise. Reference Accumulation overrides it.
helio.debug_view.tooltip: Replaces the picture with what rays see; magenta where they hit nothing. BLAS Instances: one colour per section layer. Albedo: texture × tint (entities grey). Normals: surface direction. Triangle Density: triangles in the hit BLAS, blue (few) to red (many). Materials: water blue, glass cyan, foliage green, metal yellow, gem pink, glowing red.
helio.dlss.download_failed: Download failed. See the log, or copy the debug report.
helio.check.title: Helio is off
helio.check.no_vulkan: Set Options > Video Settings > Graphics API to Vulkan, then restart.
helio.check.no_rt: This GPU or driver has no Vulkan ray tracing. Helio needs an NVIDIA RTX GPU.
helio.check.no_dlss: DLSS isn't supported here (needs an NVIDIA RTX GPU). Ray tracing still works.
helio.check.dlss_failed: DLSS couldn't start. Copy the debug report in Helio settings.
